title: Describing people
about: How to describe people: height, weight, hair, eyes, face and age. Also simple questions like How tall is he? and What does she look like?

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Про зріст людини кажуть tall, а не high. Hair (волосся на голові) — без -s: long hair, а не long hairs. Зовнішність описують так: She is tall, але She has (got) long hair — не «She is long hair». Вік — з дієсловом be: I'm 12, а не I have 12 years. І будь уважним: деякі слова звучать неввічливо. Краще не казати людині в обличчя fat, thin, ugly чи old. Ввічливіше — slim, elderly, а про вагу й вроду краще взагалі не говорити.

rows: She has (got) long hair. / Her hair is long.
How much do you weigh? / How heavy are you?

items.pattern: be tall · a tall man / woman
items.meaning: big from your feet to the top of your head; the opposite of short
items.example: Our new neighbour is very **tall**. He has to bend his head at the door.
more: My cousin is only eleven, but she's already **tall**.
Giraffes are the **tallest** animals in the world.
items.watchOut: Про людей кажуть tall, а не high: She's tall. High — про гори, полиці, стелю: a high mountain, a high shelf.

items.meaning: not tall; small from your feet to your head
items.example: My grandma is quite **short**, so I help her get things from the top shelf.
more: I'm the **shortest** person in my family.
He's **short**, but he's the fastest runner in our team.
items.watchOut: Short — і «низький» про людину, і «короткий» про волосся чи сукню: short hair. Low про зріст людей зазвичай не кажуть.

items.meaning: not tall and not short
items.example: My best friend is **medium height** with long dark hair.
more: Mum isn't tall or short. She's of **medium height**.
Most of the boys in my class are **medium height**.
items.watchOut: Кажуть medium height або average height, а не middle height.

items.meaning: thin in a nice, healthy way
items.example: My aunt does yoga every day. She's tall and **slim**.
more: Dancers are usually **slim** and strong.
The man in the blue jacket is **slim** and has got a beard.
items.watchOut: Slim — ввічливе, приємне слово: стрункий. Thin — просто «худий», іноді звучить так, ніби людина надто худа.

items.meaning: with very little fat on the body, sometimes too little
items.example: My cousin was very **thin** after he was ill.
more: This street dog is too **thin**. Let's give it some food.
Grandad is tall and **thin**, and he walks very fast.
items.watchOut: Thin часто звучить так, ніби людина надто худа. Щоб зробити комплімент, кажи slim.

items.meaning: heavier than is good for your health
items.example: The vet says our dog is **overweight**. He needs more walks.
more: Our cat is a bit **overweight** because she sleeps all day.
Our neighbour's dog gets lots of treats, so he's a bit **overweight**.
items.watchOut: Overweight звучить м'якше й ввічливіше, ніж fat. Але про чужу вагу краще взагалі не говорити в обличчя.

items.meaning: with a lot of fat on the body; big and round
items.example: Look at that **fat** pigeon! People give it too much bread.
more: In the cartoon, the cat is big, orange and **fat**.
My hamster is getting **fat** because he eats all day.
items.watchOut: Fat може образити людину. Про тварин і героїв мультфільмів так казати нормально, а про людей ввічливіше overweight.

items.pattern: have (got) dark hair · her hair is dark
items.meaning: hair that is black or dark brown
items.example: Both my parents have got **dark hair**.
more: My little brother has **dark hair** and brown eyes.
Her **hair is dark** and curly.
items.watchOut: Hair (волосся на голові) — незлічуване: dark hair, а не dark hairs. A hair — це одна волосина.

items.meaning: skin that is brown or black
items.example: My friend Amina has **dark skin** and beautiful black hair.
more: Our new neighbour has **dark skin** and short black hair.
The girl in the painting has **dark skin** and a big smile.

items.meaning: hair that is yellow or very light in colour
items.example: My little sister has **blonde hair** and blue eyes.
more: Dad had **fair hair** when he was a boy, but now it's dark.
Is your mum's hair **blonde**? — No, it's dark.
items.watchOut: Про світле волосся зазвичай кажуть blonde або fair. White hair — це сиве волосся літніх людей. Пишуть і blond, особливо про чоловіків та в американській англійській.

items.meaning: skin that is very light in colour
items.example: People with **fair skin** need sun cream in summer.
more: My cousin has **fair skin** and red hair.
My baby brother has very **fair skin** and blue eyes.
items.watchOut: Fair тут означає «світлий». Не плутай з іншим значенням: fair — чесний, справедливий (It's not fair!).

items.pattern: have (got) long hair · her hair is long
items.meaning: hair that comes down a long way
items.example: My best friend has **long hair**. It comes down to her waist.
more: In his old photos, Dad has **long hair**!
Do you like **long hair** or short hair?
items.watchOut: Кажуть She has (got) long hair або Her hair is long, а не She is long hair.

items.pattern: have (got) short hair · his hair is short
items.meaning: hair that is not long
items.example: Our football coach has **short hair** and a big smile.
more: I want **short hair** for the summer.
My granny's **hair is short** and grey.

items.meaning: the colour of your eyes
items.example: My baby sister has big **blue eyes**.
more: Most people in my family have **brown eyes**.
Our cat has bright **green eyes**.
items.watchOut: Карі очі англійською — brown eyes. І блакитні, і сині очі — blue eyes.

items.pattern: have (got) a beard · grow a beard
items.meaning: hair that grows on a man's chin and face
items.example: Grandad has a long white **beard**, like Father Christmas.
more: My uncle has a **beard** and glasses.
Dad wants to grow a **beard** this winter.
items.watchOut: Вимова /bɪəd/ — як на початку слова beer, а не «берд» (bird — птах).

items.meaning: hair that grows above a man's mouth
items.example: My uncle has a big black **moustache**.
more: The man in the picture has a **moustache** but no beard.
Dad had a **moustache** in his old school photos.
items.watchOut: Вимова /məˈstɑːʃ/, наголос на другому складі. Вуса — a moustache, в однині. Американською пишуть mustache.

items.pattern: sb has got + hair / eyes / a beard · she's got = she has got
items.meaning: has; we often use it to say how people look
items.example: My sister **has got** curly red hair.
more: I**'ve got** brown eyes, like my mum.
**Has** your teacher **got** long hair?
items.watchOut: Українською кажуть «у неї світле волосся» без дієслова. Англійською дієслово потрібне: She has got fair hair (або She has fair hair). Питання: Has she got…? або Does she have…?

items.pattern: be beautiful · a beautiful woman / girl
items.meaning: very, very nice to look at; very pretty
items.example: In the old photo, Grandma looks really **beautiful**.
more: My aunt looked **beautiful** in her long blue dress.
Our town looks **beautiful** in the snow.
items.watchOut: Beautiful кажуть про жінок, дітей, а ще про місця й речі (a beautiful view). Про чоловіків зазвичай кажуть good-looking або handsome.

items.meaning: nice to look at (often about men, but also about women)
items.example: The actor in this film is very **good-looking**.
more: Dad was a **good-looking** young man in his old photos.
Your brother is really **good-looking**!
items.watchOut: Пишуть з дефісом: good-looking. Не «good-looked» і не «good-look».

items.meaning: nice to look at (usually about girls and women)
items.example: Your little sister is so **pretty** with her curly hair.
more: You look very **pretty** in that dress!
The girl in the painting is very **pretty**.
items.watchOut: Pretty кажуть зазвичай про дівчат і жінок. Про хлопця кажуть good-looking.

items.meaning: not nice to look at; the opposite of beautiful or good-looking
items.example: In the story, the **ugly** duckling becomes a beautiful swan.
more: I don't like this **ugly** brown sofa.
The monster in the cartoon is green and **ugly**.
items.watchOut: Ugly — дуже різке слово. Про людей його краще не казати. Про речі, казкових чудовиськ — можна.

items.meaning: not ugly and not beautiful; looks like most people
items.example: I'm not a film star. I'm just **average-looking**!
more: The boy in the story is **average-looking**, but he's very brave.
In the film, the spy is **average-looking**, so nobody notices him.

items.meaning: has lived or been here for a lot of years; not young or new
items.example: Our dog is very **old**. He's fifteen and sleeps a lot.
more: This tree is very **old**. It's 300 years old.
Grandad says he's too **old** for computer games.
items.watchOut: Про людей old може звучати неввічливо. Ввічливіше — elderly. Але старий будинок чи стара машина — тільки old.

items.meaning: has lived for only a few years; not old
items.example: My brother is too **young** to go to school. He's four.
more: Our teacher is very **young**. She's only 23.
Mum had very long hair when she was **young**.
items.watchOut: Young — і «молодий», і «малий»: He's too young = він ще замалий.

items.pattern: be older (than sb) · my older sister
items.meaning: has more years than another person
items.example: My cousin is two years **older** than me.
more: I'd like to be **older** so I can stay up late.
My **older** brother is at university.
items.watchOut: Порівнюють за допомогою than: older than me, а не «older from me» чи «older of me». Старший брат — older brother (або elder brother).

items.pattern: be middle-aged · a middle-aged man / woman
items.meaning: about 40 to 60 years old
items.example: Dad is 50. He's **middle-aged**, but he still plays football.
more: The bus driver was a **middle-aged** man with a moustache.
Our neighbours are **middle-aged** and have two dogs.
items.watchOut: Пишуть з дефісом: middle-aged. Middle age — це іменник (середній вік): Many people start running in middle age. Не плутай з medium height — середній зріст.

items.pattern: be younger (than sb) · my younger brother
items.meaning: has fewer years than another person
items.example: My **younger** sister is seven.
more: Grandma would like to be **younger** so she can go skiing again.
Mum is three years **younger** than Dad.
items.watchOut: Молодший брат — younger brother (або little brother). Порівнюють з than: younger than me.

items.pattern: elderly people · an elderly man / woman
items.meaning: old (a more polite word)
items.example: We help an **elderly** woman next door with her shopping.
more: There are special seats on the bus for **elderly** people.
An **elderly** man asked me the way to the station.
items.watchOut: Elderly — ввічливіше, ніж old, але тільки про людей. Стара машина чи старий будинок — old.

items.pattern: How tall is sb? — She's 1.60 metres (tall).
items.meaning: a question and answer about someone's height
items.uk: Якого він зросту? — Його зріст 1 метр 60.
items.example: **How tall** is your dad? — He's 1.90 metres.
more: I'm 1.55 **metres tall**.
**How tall** are you now? You look bigger!
items.watchOut: Звичайне питання — How tall are you? What is your height? кажуть рідше, більш офіційно. How high are you? — неправильно. 1.60 читають one metre sixty.

items.phrase: How much do you weigh? / How heavy are you?
items.pattern: How much does sb weigh? · How heavy is sb? · I weigh 40 kilos.
items.meaning: questions about someone's weight
items.example: **How much does** your dog **weigh**? — About ten kilos.
more: The new baby **weighs** four kilos.
**How heavy is** your cat? She looks very big.
items.watchOut: Weigh — дієслово (важити), weight — іменник (вага). Кажуть I weigh 40 kilos, а не I weight 40 kilos. Вимова weigh — /weɪ/, gh не читається.

items.pattern: How old is sb? — She's 12 (years old).
items.meaning: a question and answer about someone's age
items.example: **How old** is your sister? — She's nine.
more: My grandad **is** 84, but he still rides a bike.
**How old** were you when you learned to swim?
items.watchOut: Вік — з дієсловом be: I'm 12, а не I have 12 years. Можна I'm 12 years old, але не просто I'm 12 years.

items.pattern: What does she look like? — She's tall and dark.
items.meaning: a question about how someone looks: height, hair, face
items.example: **What does** your new teacher **look like**? — She's short with curly hair.
more: **What do** your cousins **look like**? Are they tall?
I don't know **what** he **looks like**. Has he got a beard?
items.watchOut: What does she look like? — про зовнішність (She's tall and slim). What is she like? — про характер (She's kind and funny). І не кажи «How does she look like?»: тут потрібне what.

warmup.explain: Про зріст людини — tall. High — про гори, полиці, стелю.

warmup.uk: У моєї подруги довге світле волосся.
warmup.q: My friend has got long blonde ___.
warmup.explain: Волосся на голові — hair, без -s і без a. A hair — одна волосина.
Вік — з дієсловом be: I'm twelve. Не «I have twelve years».

warmup.q: What ___ your new teacher look like?
warmup.explain: Питання про зовнішність: What does she look like? Teacher — одна людина, тому does.
Weigh — дієслово «важити». Weight — іменник «вага», heavy — прикметник «важкий».
Середній зріст — medium height (або average height), не middle height.
Середнього віку — middle-aged, з дефісом і -d. Middle age — іменник, medium height — про зріст.

warmup.uk: Моя сестра на три роки старша за мене.
warmup.q: My sister is three years older ___ me.
warmup.explain: Після older, younger, taller — than: older than me. Не «from me».

A.explain: Про зріст людини — tall. High кажуть про гори чи полиці.

A.q: My sister isn't tall or short. She's ___.
A.explain: Не високий і не низький — medium height.

A.q: Our dog eats too much. The vet says he's ___.
A.explain: Важить більше, ніж треба, — overweight. Thin і slim — навпаки, худий і стрункий.

B.explain: Волосся — hair, без -s. Довгих очей не буває.

B.q: Dad has got a ___ above his mouth, but no beard.
B.explain: Волосся над губою — moustache (вуса). Beard — борода на підборідді.

B.q: Grandad says, "I'm not ugly, and I'm not a film star. I'm just ___."
B.explain: Не негарний і не красень — average-looking, звичайної зовнішності.

C.q: Grandma's friend is 85. A polite word for her is ___.
C.explain: Ввічливе слово замість old — elderly. Middle-aged — це приблизно 40–60 років.

C.q: My brother is 8 and I'm 11. He's ___ than me.
C.explain: У нього менше років — younger than me. Young без -er не вживають із than.
40–60 років — middle-aged. Middle age — іменник, elderly — літній.

D.q: How ___ is your sister? — She's 1.40 metres.
D.explain: Питання про зріст людини — How tall…?

D.q: How old is Anna? — She ___ ten.
D.explain: Вік — з дієсловом be: She's ten. Не «She has ten».

D.q: What does your cousin look like? — ___
D.right: He's tall and has got fair hair.
D.explain: Look like — про зовнішність. Про характер питають What is he like? — He's kind and funny.

example.title: Our new teacher
example.uk:
У понеділок ми познайомилися з нашою новою вчителькою англійської, місіс Браун. Після школи мама запитала: «Як вона виглядає?»

«Вона висока й струнка, — сказала я. — У неї коротке волосся і блакитні очі. Думаю, вона середнього віку».

«Вона приємна?» — запитала мама.

«Так, вона дуже добра. Її син Макс навчається в класі мого брата. Він молодший за мене. У нього світла шкіра й біляве волосся, і він дуже веселий».
example.en:
On Monday we met our new English teacher, Mrs Brown. After school, Mum asked, "[[What does she look like|d4]]?"

"She's [[tall|a1]] and [[slim|a4]]," I said. "She [[has got|b10]] [[short hair|b6]] and [[blue eyes|b7]]. I think she's [[middle-aged|c4]]."

"Is she nice?" asked Mum.

"Yes, she's very kind. Her son Max is in my brother's class. He's [[younger|c5]] than me. He has [[fair skin|b4]] and [[blonde hair|b3]], and he's very funny."
